newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two Japanese regional banks to list on TSE.
newsitem.headline: Two Japanese regional banks to list on TSE.

text.p: Japanese regional banks Tokushima Bank Ltd and Mie Bank Ltd will list on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on December 20, the exchange said on Thursday.

Shares in Tokushima Bank, a regional bank based in Tokushima Prefecture, are currently listed on the first section of the Osaka Securities Exchange, while those of Mie Bank are listed on the first section of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
The two banks will not issue new shares when they list on the TSE, the bourse said in a statement.
